name: Astronot
scene: An astronaut floats diagonally through sweeping orbital bands of deep blue space.
notes: Redrawn from motif_astronaut with fox and lighthouse design sheets as style references. Target 73–113 panes. Warm astronaut including visor; blue-only space. Portrait oval, white exterior. Generated and visually reviewed, then regenerated once for flat fills and separated junctions. Remaining concerns: subtle fill variation persists; some same-colour adjacent pieces may merge during tracing; possible four-way junctions remain at chest and middle-right background, with narrow helmet strips and incomplete/faint seams at right shoulder, left upper arm and raised knee. Pane count and geometry are not yet validated; resolve these in tracing while preserving subject contours. Design sheet only.
